tasks.prompt:
Look at the current positions of the banana and the mug.
If the banana's X-coordinate is LESS than the mug's
X-coordinate (banana more to the left), pick the banana and
lift it 10 cm. Otherwise pick the mug and lift it 10 cm.
Report which one you picked and why.

Visit each of the 6 graspable objects in turn — banana, mug,
bottle, screwdriver, duck, lego. For each, move the EE 5 cm
above the object, hover briefly, and report whether the
gripper is holding anything. Return home at the end.

Get the positions of the mug and the bottle. Compute the
midpoint (average X, Y; Z plus 5 cm). Move the EE to that
midpoint and report whether you reached it. Don't grasp.

Trace the letter L in the air with the end-effector. The
tool moves to ABSOLUTE Cartesian targets, so first read your
current pose, then: (1) move down 4 cm (lower Z by 0.04 m),
(2) from there move forward 4 cm (raise X by 0.04 m), then
(3) return home. Both corners are within the workspace.
Report the end-effector pose at each corner.

Pick up the lego brick. Move it directly above the duck.
Lower it to about 3 cm above the duck's Z position. Release
the gripper. Return to home. The lego should rest on/near
the duck after physics settles.

Pick up the duck. Move it directly above the mug. Lower to
about 4 cm above the mug, then release. Duck should end up
inside or on top of the mug.

Move the end-effector to world position [0.20, 0.0, 0.20].
DO NOT knock over the bottle. Plan a path that stays clear.
Do NOT grasp anything.

Swap positions of banana and bottle. (1) Record both positions.
(2) Pick banana, park at [0.10, 0.20, 0.10], release.
(3) Pick bottle, move to banana's original XY, release.
(4) Pick banana from park, move to bottle's original XY,
release. (5) Return home.

Pick up the screwdriver. Place it at the target XY (0.15, 0.15).
Lower to 5 cm above the table, release, retract. Return home.
Screwdriver must end up resting stably near (0.15, 0.15).

Build a 3-object tower in the order (bottom-to-top):
mug, lego, duck. Steps: (1) place lego on top of mug
(use the mug's XY, just above mug's height), (2) place
duck on top of the lego (same XY, slightly higher).
Use the agent-written gripper_close for each grasp.
Return home after building.

tasks.prompt:
Observe the positions of all 6 graspable objects
(banana, mug, bottle, screwdriver, duck, lego). Pick up
the one whose Y-coordinate is the LARGEST (most forward
in the world frame). Lift it 10 cm. Report which object
you picked and its Y coordinate.

Perform two object swaps in sequence:
(1) swap banana and mug — banana goes to mug's XY,
    mug goes to banana's original XY.
(2) then swap bottle and screwdriver — bottle goes to
    screwdriver's XY, screwdriver goes to bottle's
    original XY.
Use the parking position [0.0, 0.20, 0.10] for the
temporary hold. Return home at the end.
